channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Frank Wright — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-25
item.description: “Respect should be earned by actions, and not acquired by years.” — Frank Wright

item.title: Abraham Lincoln — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-24
item.description: “I will prepare and some day my chance will come.” — Abraham Lincoln

item.title: Kalpana Chawla — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-23
item.description: “When you look at the stars and the galaxy, you feel that you are not just from any particular piece of land, but from the solar system.” — Kalpana Chawla

item.title: Mark Twain — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-22
item.description: “The man who does not read has no advantage over the man who cannot read.” — Mark Twain

item.title: Rumi — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-21
item.description: “Do not grieve. Anything you lose comes round in another form.” — Rumi

item.title: Sun Tzu — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-20
item.description: “You can be sure of succeeding in your attacks if you only attack places which are undefended.” — Sun Tzu

item.title: Helen Keller — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-19
item.description: “What I am looking for is not out there, it is in me.” — Helen Keller

item.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-18
item.description: “What is hell? I maintain that it is the suffering of being unable to love.” — Fyodor Dostoevsky
